items.text: As head of a group of legislators, warned party leaders that the group's members would withhold their votes from any funding bill carrying an extension of the expanded premium subsidies.

After the budget law passed, said its work requirements and its limits on the financing arrangements regional governments use would discourage further expansion of public health coverage for low-income residents.
Cosponsored a bill to phase down over eight years the higher national funding share for adults added to low-income public health coverage until it equals the regular share.
